name: Thomas Augot
bio: I’m a French developer from Nantes, now based in Gran Canaria. A curious and adventurous mind took me around the world on a backpack for years — from Australia to the USA, across Asia and beyond. A few years ago I switched careers after discovering coding, and for more than 3 years I’ve been building skills every day to become a versatile, end‑to‑end developer who can shape products from idea to polished experience.
